subject: Rust lease released: 21/21 pass, ABI 1184/11592, new cdylib 2aa21057
body: One-shot rebuild complete; host is free for the next Rust/Mesa build. Production air_bridge.rs copied verbatim to the private harness and built with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1. `cargo test --release` 21/21 PASS; `cargo build --release` produced libtegu_air_bridge.so SHA256 2aa21057ecd315a1b66a49c3306457035af8b390d666e6f43f4b6dd09d517ec6. ABI printed: r=160 d=64 reg=1184 v=11592 vh=36 desc=72 regions=2120 reg_flags=24 reg_cc=28 reg_const=32 reg_push=1056. The new real-probe test `graphics_specialization_tests::real_generic_linear_sampler_is_not_projected_to_nearest` passes against authored probe.air: old plan_generic refuses linear sampler facts; new generic_specialized returns the same GenericPlan plus per-stage constants, exact Vk/Metal view formats, and specialization key. No Mesa/native build done; lease released now.
